source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (API 0.6 map call, Oct 30 2026), filtered to the club: the 18 hole ways (pars and handicaps agree with golfcourseapi's card on all 18), the 18 greens the lines end in, tee boxes, bunkers, fairways (OSM's multipolygons with their bunkers and islands cut out), rough, ponds and the marked lateral hazards within 100 m of a hole line, woods within 120 m, the club outline as the boundary. Made by scripts/crystalfalls/convert.py.
source.caveat: Not traced by hand: as accurate as OSM. Yellow Creek and its feeders are OSM waterway centrelines buffered 3.5 m each side (q osm+buffer, as at Creekside), so a ball read as water is a ball within ~4 m of the mapped centreline; a wider pool reads rough. Not field-checked.
source.woods: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud (GA_Statewide_B3_2018, s3://usgs-lidar-public): every 1 m cell whose highest return stands 3 m or more above the bare earth and holds high-vegetation points, within 75 m of a hole line, off the mapped turf, bunkers and water (scripts/lidar-trees/, D133).

imagery.release: World Imagery Wayback release 43291 (Oct 29 2026): the current leaf-on capture — green fairways, sharp; every release back to Apr 2026 (49059) is the same capture, the 2023-2025 ones are a hazier dormant one

elevation.source: USGS 3DEP (elevation.nationalmap.gov 3DEPElevation ImageServer getSamples, bilinear; 1 m lidar where flown), via scripts/fetch-3dep.mjs

greenGrids.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (elevation.nationalmap.gov ImageServer getSamples, bilinear), via scripts/fetch-green-slopes.mjs
